title: Mario finds his right B-52 pilot glove missing from his bag
place_text: Ellsworth AFB / Mario's home, Rapid City, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I did everything. And my left hand glove was there, but the right hand glove is gone.

plain: In 1977, an Air Force veteran named Mario Woods says he checked his bag at home near Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota and found his left B-52 bomber pilot glove there but the right one gone. He tells it as something that happened to him, and he ties it to what he and a fellow airman, Michael Johnson, say happened to them that night: a taking by aliens.
